symptoms.symptom: Automatic icemaker does not work (on some models)

causes.label: Icemaker power switch is not on.
remedies: On power switch models, set the power switch to the I (on) position.
On feeler arm models, move the feeler arm to the ON (down) position.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 27: "Icemaker power switch is not on."

causes.label: Water supply turned off or not connected.
remedies: See Installing the water line.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 27: "Water supply turned off or not connected."

causes.label: Freezer compartment too warm.
remedies: Wait 24 hours for the refrigerator to completely cool down.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 27: "Freezer compartment too warm."

causes.label: Piled up cubes in the storage bin cause the icemaker to shut off.
remedies: Level cubes by hand.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 27: "Piled up cubes in the storage bin cause the icemaker to shut off."

causes.label: Icemaker is on but the water supply to the refrigerator has not been connected.
remedies: Turn the icemaker off.
On power switch models, set the power switch to the O (off) position.
On feeler arm models, move the feeler arm to the STOP (up) position.
Keeping it on will damage the water valve.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 27: "Icemaker is on but the water supply to the refrigerator has not been connected."
